title: Exclude chosen agents when round robin uses a team's members

Round Robin → Assign Ticket to Teams
text: Round-robin target "Assign Ticket to: Team" has an "Exclude agents from this assignment" option to leave chosen team members out.
Not seen live: the Zoho trial org has no team, so the option could not be opened.
